theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_rc_boundary_ray_test
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), C.boundary = 0 → ∀ (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid P → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), G e t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), G e t * deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (s • e)) t = 0
